## Why visit

One of the best combinations of traditional beer and decorative detail in either city. The passage around the bar, coloured tilework, elaborate glass and glazed lounge dome deserve a slow look rather than a doorway photograph. Its compact layout makes the preservation tangible: you drink inside the old arrangement of rooms and service screens. The cask-led offer and cold pork pies suit a pause between the larger Dale Street beer houses. For pub interiors, give the Lion equal billing with the much more frequently photographed Philharmonic.

## Beer

Changing cask ales; official site advertises eight handpumps, while CAMRA’s listed beer count is lower. Do not assume every pump is pouring. CAMRA lists Otter Bitter as a regular cask lead; changing guests have included Higsons and Love Lane.

## Food

Cold Coward’s of Frodsham pork pies are advertised. The pub says it does not serve a full food menu.

## Plan the visit

A substantial whisky selection and jukebox are part of the offer. Pub food wording refers to pies, not a kitchen.

**Getting there:** Beside Moorfields station; easy to join to Vernon Arms, Denbigh Castle and Ship & Mitre.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
